    Relations of a piece in its path algebra #

    For a finite piece S of the universal cover, the relations of the cover are the elements w(l) of the path algebra k D_S for paths l with zero composite and w(l) - w(l') for parallel paths with equal composites (relGens). A representation respects the cover exactly when these elements act by zero on its total space (respectsCover_iff): with the identity labelling a word acts as its own path operator (pdAct_id_word). This is the first step of the bridge from representations of pieces to modules over the piece algebra.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Rep.lab_id {D : FinQuiver} (l : List D.A) :
    lab (FinQuiver.Hom.id D) l = {l}
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Rep.pdAct_id_word {k : Type u} [Field k] {D : FinQuiver} (X : Rep k D) (l : List D.A) :
    (pdAct (FinQuiver.Hom.id D) X) (FinQuiver.word k D l) = X.pathTot l
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Rep.pdVert_id {k : Type u} [Field k] {D : FinQuiver} (X : Rep k D) (q : D.V) :
    pdVert (FinQuiver.Hom.id D) X q = X.idm q

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Rep.pdArr_id {k : Type u} [Field k] {D : FinQuiver} (X : Rep k D) (c : D.A) :
